research_question: With the pinned Pyquaticus easy-mode ATTACK and DEFEND semantics unchanged, does changing the 4v4 team composition from 4A/0D through 0A/4D produce pole-dependent behavior or outcome differences?
scientific_delta: Change only the number of fixed ATTACK and DEFEND roles. Keep the semantic controllers, opponent poles, environment, action adapter, seed pairing, and telemetry unchanged from the completed 4v4 assignment evaluation.
claim_boundary: This tests fixed scripted role composition in this project's CTF dynamics. It does not reproduce native Pyquaticus performance, establish learned roles, identify a causal PPO repair, or authorize 6v6.

adapter_contract.attack_any_friendly_carrier: GO_HOME macro with the already-validated non-carrier home-legality branch
adapter_contract.defend: unified DEFEND macro id 7 with live target re-derivation

prerequisites.old_aggregate_g6: retained historical failure; not used as a team-evaluation gate

execution.speed_caveat: Pyquaticus easy-mode speed intent is retained, but physical integration uses this project's dynamics. Native Pyquaticus performance is not claimed.

canonical_assignment.definition: For defender count D, stable ids 0 through D-1 are DEFEND and the remaining ids are ATTACK. Compute once at reset and hold for the episode.
canonical_assignment.tie_break: not applicable; identity order is fixed

cells.definition: 2 opponent poles x 5 role compositions = 10 paired cells
cells.only_cell_delta: role composition; all identity ordering and semantic controllers remain frozen

estimands_and_decision_rules.primary_per_cell: Blue win rate, score difference, draw rate, episode length, and role telemetry with 95% paired-seed bootstrap intervals.
estimands_and_decision_rules.composition_effect: For each pole, compare every non-2A/2D composition against the frozen 2A/2D baseline on win rate and score difference using paired seeds.
estimands_and_decision_rules.regime_effect: Report paired B-minus-A contrasts for every composition. These are descriptive regime contrasts, not a new strategic-demand certification.
estimands_and_decision_rules.regime_composition_signal: A conservative descriptive signal requires a non-baseline composition whose win-rate contrast versus 2A/2D has opposite signs on Pole A and Pole B and whose two pole-specific intervals both exclude zero. Otherwise report no demonstrated regime-dependent composition signal.
estimands_and_decision_rules.multiplicity: All contrasts are exploratory. Intervals are descriptive and do not authorize PPO, architecture selection, or 6v6 from a nominal interval exclusion alone.

held_identical: GET_FLAG, GO_HOME, and unified DEFEND adapter
Pole A and Pole B certified opponent definitions
map, rules, horizon, speed intent, telemetry, and statistics
isolation.only_changed_factor: number of ATTACK versus DEFEND roles under the frozen identity ordering
forbidden: adapter or opponent selection from outcomes
